name: REVIVER v23
notes: Fixes the screen button going through screens in a jumbled order (and Back bouncing between two screens) after Now Playing or another package had been drawing: the drawing overwrote the keyboard's copy of your screen list. Everything from v22: your own screen list (Screens tab), a screen for every screen package, changeable boot logo, the image screen, live drawing, tear-free scrolling, screen-off support.
